raw: Nobody in the service centre can sign in to the case portal this morning. Every workstation returns account unavailable and the phones are backing up because agents cannot open customer records.
I am the only payroll approver on duty and the approval portal keeps rejecting my sign-in. The payment file must be authorised by 14:00 today or staff will be paid late.
SSO on my replacement laptop returns to the username screen after I authenticate. My old laptop still works and nobody else has reported it.
Please add my account to the read-only archive group for the customer history application. This is for a new responsibility next month and nothing is currently blocked.
Card authorisation is failing for every online order across all regions. Customers reach the payment step but no transaction can complete and there is no alternate checkout route.
Roughly one in ten orders sent to the courier API fail on the first attempt. Retrying succeeds, but the warehouse queue is growing and dispatch is materially delayed.
The events from our feedback form occasionally create two CRM activities instead of one. Six records are affected and staff can delete the extras; there is no deadline.
Could you register a sandbox callback URL for the supplier test environment? This is preparation for work planned next quarter and production is unaffected.
All advisers in the contact centre say their virtual desktops take several minutes to respond and calls cannot be handled. Other offices are normal but this entire department has stopped.
The annual compliance report times out whenever the full period is selected. A smaller range works, but the signed report is due to the regulator tomorrow afternoon.
Searching old opportunities in CRM now takes about thirty seconds for me. The results do arrive, my colleagues are unaffected, and I have no work due against it.
The team dashboard refresh takes around ninety seconds instead of twenty, but it completes and all figures are available. This is affecting two analysts with no deadline or blocked work.
Duplicate supplier accounts are causing the payment approval batch to reject today. Finance can merge them manually, but the approved file must reach treasury before the 16:00 cutoff.
Tax totals on confirmations are wrong for a large group of customers. Support can resend corrected documents manually, but the error is creating a significant queue of complaints.
My exported customer list contains three duplicate rows. The records in the application are correct, I can remove the rows in the spreadsheet, and nothing is time-sensitive.
Please standardise Ltd and LTD in the supplier display names when convenient. Matching and payments already work; this is a presentation cleanup request.
The overnight processing chain stopped before producing any operational reports. Every business unit is without today's figures and teams cannot begin their daily processing.

Loading the full ledger view in the finance system takes about four minutes for the two people doing month-end. It does finish and nobody else is affected, but the close has to be signed off on Thursday.
Only I have stopped receiving the Monday inventory email. Everyone else receives it and I can open the same figures in the reporting portal.
Please move my monthly utilisation email from the first Monday to the second Monday starting next quarter. The existing schedule is working.
Please fix the portal urgently. This is unacceptable and senior management are asking for updates.
The red message is back again after what you did last time. Can somebody apply the same fix before lunch?
Morning team, hope you are well. Several people have mentioned the usual problem and it is becoming frustrating. I have meetings all day, so please investigate as soon as possible.
Need access for the new contractor today please.
The report is wrong and the board pack is due tomorrow. Please correct it.
Nobody can work because the system is down. Treat this as the highest priority.
It failed with the message in the screenshot I sent separately.
The transfer issue has happened again for the same customer. You already know which one.
Cannot get into the site since this morning.
The duplicates are back. There are loads of them and it needs sorting today.
